credits.title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
credits.overview: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

credits.title: Flipping for Christmas
credits.overview: Right before Christmas, realtor Abigail agrees to help her sister with what she believes will be an easy flip of an inherited home. Things get tricky when the co-beneficiary Bo has a different idea.
